conflicts.where: Lessons 3, 6 and 7 (ugali daily data and median)
conflicts.problem: The lessons give different five-day datasets for the same phenomenon. Lesson 3 uses 54, 60, 57, 60, 59 (median 59, which the overview wrongly states as 58 at one point). Lesson 6 uses 55, 60, 58, 60, 57 (median 58). Lesson 7 uses a 7-day set with median 57. Phenomenon text gives median 57. Lessons 3, 6 and 7 disagree on the data and on the median.

Lesson 5 uses a frequency table totalling 150 orders with ugali 56 (37%), contradicting the phenomenon and the other lessons (120 learners, ugali 47%). Lesson 4 says ugali about 55–60 out of 120. Lesson 5's table also sums wrongly: 56+30+14+28+22 = 150, but 56/150 = 37.3%, not matching 47%.

Lesson 4 says it retrieves the raw data from Lesson 1, but Lesson 2 builds the tally sheet and Lesson 3 says the frequency table was built in Lesson 2, while Lesson 4 builds it. Lesson 7 says the mean was calculated in Lesson 5 though it was Lessons 3 and 6. The sequence is inconsistent.
